newsitem.title: USA: U.S-based O'Brien Partners named adviser in China.
newsitem.headline: U.S-based O'Brien Partners named adviser in China.

text.p: O'Brien Partners Inc, a New York-based municipal bond financial advisory firm, has been named a financial adviser to a Chinese province, sources familiar with the appointment said Monday.

It is believed this is the first time a U.S. independent municipal financial advisory firm has been appointed to serve as an adviser to a Chinese province, the sources and municipal advisory officials said. A number of U.S. securities firms have already been working in China on various projects.

O'Brien Partners, which provides financial advisory services to municipal issuers in the U.S, including the Southern California Public Power Authority, was tapped last week to provide advice on structured and municipal finance to the Jiangsu province, located on the central coast near Shanghai, the sources said.
Officials of O'Brien Partners and the province could not be reached for immediate comment.
The sources said an offering was being considered for the province but declined to disclose the details.
O'Brien Partners was ranked fourth in the U.S. as a financial adviser to municipal issuers, according to Newark-based data provider Securities Data Co.

Chester Johnson, chairman of New York-based Government Finance Associates Inc and former of chairman of the National Association of Independent Public Finance Advisers, said this is the first time an independent U.S. municipal advisory firm has been appointed to such a post in China.

"This obviously a good example of the talents and expertise we can provide," said Johnson, whose firm worked on public finance projects in the former Soviet Union. "It is great news for the expertise and independence that independent advisers can bring to developing countries and infrastructure worldwide."
